steps.content: Afterward, the Ring Research Institute spends two full days conducting a secondary sweep and structural reassessment of the Bureau's underground sector.

Faced with a report thick enough to bludgeon a person dead, Nightingale reads it through, falls into a long silence, and in the end merely sets the file down with care before turning to arrange new maintenance rotations and security shifts.
The incident is ultimately classified in a string of rigorous, officially worded conclusions.
But in the words of those who lived through it—

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Okay, okay, listen, little mouse, you're not gonna believe this. We cleared this absolutely insane, ultra-hard secret dungeon. Under the Bureau.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: And the place was completely cursed! Slimes, coin banks, you name it... Oh, and get this: there was this Mania thing, like, the embodiment of bad luck, and it totally had us on the ropes the whole time. Good thing I... I mean, good thing we pulled off some serious clutch plays, or we would not have made it out of there!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Pfft. A scrub's a scrub. You got your ass kicked, and you're still out here bragging about it.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Oh, right, forgot to mention, Chief was there too.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What?! That dummy had something this fun going on and didn't even tell me?!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: We were out on a field mission at the time.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ugh, I don't wanna hear it! And anyway, couldn't you have just messaged me on the terminal? Obviously I would've rushed right back if I knew!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Adjutant Nightingale said the comms were blocked by the Mania field.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hmph. Next time something like this goes down, I'm definitely not missing it!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Yeah. Next time.
[Scene Change]
In its post-incident review, the Ring Research Institute concluded that Murphy's "misfortune" was not eradicated, but rather brought into a more stable equilibrium.

Though drawn into the incident by misfortune, and though she came face to face with Mania, it was in reckoning with that Mania—and through it—that she finally found herself with something more than misfortune alone.

Of course, the institute supervisor who gifted away the experimental material was also suspended from his position. For the days ahead, he will serve as a member of the MBCC maintenance crew, helping repair the damage wrought upon the Bureau.
And so—
A long, long time later...
Oh wait, maybe... not that long after all.
For DisCity, managing to get through an entire week without incident is already an accomplishment worthy of the history books.
Anyway, on what seems like an utterly ordinary workday—though, in truth, not quite so ordinary—

steps.speaker: Bureau Staff Member
steps.content: Mania response detected from Sinner Murphy! Move to detain!

steps.speaker: Bureau Staff Member
steps.content: Attention all units, Sinner Murphy's misfortune abilities remain active! Stay sharp!

steps.speaker: Bureau Staff Member
steps.content: What?! The containment net short-circuited one second before deployment and tangled up three of our own people?!

steps.speaker: Bureau Staff Member
steps.content: Team One, pull back! Team Two, move in, now! Go, go!

steps.speaker: Bureau Staff Member
steps.content: Team Two? Team Two, report! ...What do you mean the tear gas all went off at once?! You can't even see what's happening on site?!

steps.speaker: Bureau Staff Member
steps.content: Sigh... Command, Sinner Murphy's current location unknown. Requesting immediate assistance from the MBCC Chief.
[Scene Change]
The reception office is unchanged, as it always has been. Since Kiki recovered from her injury, her life has remained much the same. Yet not entirely without change—
She has lately taken to growing four-leaf clovers, after receiving seeds sent by an old friend. The seeds, her friend claimed, came from another world and would bring good fortune.
Nightingale finishes the report at last. She lifts her gaze to ${PlayerName}, seated behind the desk with a shoulder still wrapped in thick bandages, and sinks into a long silence.
In the end, she merely sets the file down with care and exhales a sigh of quiet resignation.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I've already rescheduled the maintenance and security rotations. As for your fieldwork requests, I'll be rejecting every single one of them until your injury is fully healed.
As for the red-haired figure who vanished from the reports—
Who knows?
Maybe this time, fate will actually show a little mercy, and let her stumble upon a stroke of luck, the truly good kind, around some corner where no one's watching.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Wha—?! Why did the brakes break again?!

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Chieeeef! Heeeelp!
